newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM cargo forms new business unit.
newsitem.headline: KLM cargo forms new business unit.

text.p: KLM Cargo has formed a seventh business unit named Air Logistics.

A KLM Cargo spokesman said the new unit will fill a gap between KLM Cargo Rederij which is responsible for route planning and sales and KLM Cargo Logistics which provides an integrated logistics package for any customers.
Air Logistics will handle any additional logistics services a client may request such as warehousing, transport or other services, he added.
Its other units cover special cargo, air mail, information technology and cargo service centres. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
